# Catherine Andrews

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life. She prefers to focus on the positive, noting that such a mindset is necessary given her living situation with [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

In her youth, Catherine Andrews did not gad about to halls or public places. Later, when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) canvassed the countryside to raise funds for local hall repairs on behalf of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Catherine contributed to their cause by giving them a secret donation.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_
